up: List all distinct compounds that are reported in the document with CHEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4482318'. The document is stored in the docs table and is identified by its chembl_id. Compounds associated with this document are found in the compound_records table via doc_id. For each distinct compound, retrieve its compound CHEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles) by joining through the molregno column. Do not filter by activity or impose any row limit.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4482318';
